rationale: The first reply was a generic, US-flavoured brain-dump (gas shutoff valves, outdoor vents, circuit breakers) that didn't clarify what 'won't stop' meant, though it did ask for brand/model/panel type and nothing in it was unsafe. Once the customer explained the drum turns after 'End' and stops when the door opens, the assistant correctly and promptly identified the normal anti-crease phase with appropriate confidence ('almost certainly normal'), gave sensible ways to stop/disable it via the manual, listed the right red flags (heating, running when off), and pointed to the model label location. The 'up to about 2 hours' duration is a slightly specific general claim, but no customer evidence was invented and no parts or engineer were pushed.
